fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.description: Content card: title, description, and CTA. The eyebrow comes from the Topic link and Topic fields below.

fields.name: topicLink
fields.label: Topic link
fields.description: Page the eyebrow links to. Its title is shown when Topic is blank or Dynamic eyebrow is selected.

fields.name: topicLinkText
fields.label: Topic
fields.description: Eyebrow text. Leave blank to use the title of the Topic link page.

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Presentation
fields.description: Optional modifiers. Full width removes the rounded container; alignment controls which side the content card sits on; Dynamic eyebrow ignores Topic and shows the title of the Topic link page.
